task_instance: Build and run a two-vessel AIS corridor monitor: fleet.json (MMSIs), corridors.geojson (polygon corridors), and a monitor that ingests AIS PositionReport-shaped messages, does point-in-polygon corridor testing, and appends to alerts.log when a vessel is outside its corridor for more than 10 minutes. First attempted the skill's literal step 1 (connect to wss://stream.aisstream.io/v0/stream with a company API key and subscribe to the fleet's MMSIs).
blocker_detail: The skill's core data source is the AISStream websocket, which requires a company-issued API key sent in the subscription message (no anonymous/public access exists). No such key is available in this sandbox and the safety rules forbid searching for or using credentials or account-bound services, so live AIS ingestion per step 1 cannot be performed. As independent confirmation, an actual connection attempt to wss://stream.aisstream.io/v0/stream (with a placeholder key) was made from the work directory and was also rejected outbound by the sandbox's network proxy with HTTP 403 (see test_connect.py output: 'InvalidProxyStatus proxy rejected connection: HTTP 403'), so the run would be blocked by network egress restrictions even if a real key were available. Because step 1 (the live feed) is unreachable, the full pipeline (steps 1-4, including running for at least one hour against live traffic) could not be completed end-to-end, so the skill's core stated deliverable -- monitoring the company's real chartered vessels via the live AIS feed -- was not achieved.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_div/created__skillc-bench__vessel-ais-monitor@developer-sandbox . Files produced: fleet.json (2 vessels), corridors.geojson (2 corridor polygons), monitor.py (point_in_polygon ray-casting test + 10-minute-outside alert logic per skill steps 2-3), test_connect.py (live-connection attempt proving the AISStream endpoint requires a real API key and is also blocked by the sandbox's egress proxy), run_test.py (drives monitor.py with a synthetic 60-minute stream of AIS-shaped position messages for the 2 fleet vessels, standing in for the unreachable live feed so the corridor/alert logic itself could be verified). Ran `python3 test_connect.py`: result 'CONNECT/PROTOCOL ERROR: InvalidProxyStatus proxy rejected connection: HTTP 403', confirming step 1 is blocked both by missing credentials and by network egress restrictions. Ran `python3 run_test.py`: processed 62 synthetic position reports over a simulated 60-minute window; vessel MV Delft Trader stayed inside its corridor the whole time and raised 0 alerts (correct); vessel MV North Star was moved outside its corridor at minute 20 and stayed there, producing exactly 1 alert in alerts.log once it had been outside for more than 10 minutes ('...ALERT vessel=MV North Star mmsi=205567890 lon=5.0000 lat=50.0000 outside_corridor_for=720s'), verifying the point-in-polygon test and the >10-minute alert/dedup logic (steps 2-3) work correctly on AIS-shaped data. The overall skill is rated not_achieved because step 1, the live AISStream ingestion of the company's real chartered vessels (the actual deliverable a user invokes this skill for), could not be performed.
